visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a wide shot of the iconic giant life-size Unicorn Gundam statue standing tall against a bright, cloudless blue sky in front of the DiverCity Tokyo Plaza building. Large, colorful text overlays in Chinese appear on the screen, advertising a discount coupon that offers 1,000 yen off for purchases over 3,000 yen. The lighting is harsh natural daylight, casting clear shadows on the white mechanical details of the statue. (2) A full-screen graphic of a pink promotional flyer is shown. The text, in both Chinese and Japanese, details the 'Exclusive Discount Coupon' partnership between 'Japanuts' and DiverCity Tokyo Plaza. It highlights the validity period until February 2026 and clearly states the discount terms. The background of the flyer is a soft pink, making the bold black and red text stand out. (3) The scene transitions to the interior of the mall, showing the Tourist Information and Tax-free counter. Several people are visible in the background, including staff behind the desk and tourists. A yellow variety text box warning 'limited quantity' pops up. The lighting shifts to bright, even indoor studio-style lighting. (4) A rapid montage of store storefronts follows. We see the bright red and white logo of UNIQLO, followed by the blue and white GU sign, then 'coca', and finally 'SAC'S BAR'. Each shot is a medium wide shot showing the entrance and some of the merchandise inside, like clothing racks and bags. (5) Close-up shots of specific items are shown: elegant black dresses on white mannequins in a well-lit fashion boutique, followed by a wide shot of many colorful suitcases of various sizes lined up on a display floor. The camera pans slightly across the luggage to show the variety available. (6) The video showcases 'Hello Kitty Japan' with its bright pink storefront and a large statue of Hello Kitty and other Sanrio characters stacked on top of each other. A person walks by in the background. The scene then moves to a close-up of a cooking mold where golden-brown Hello Kitty shaped waffles are being flipped with tongs. (7) Outdoors again, a person's hands hold up two enormous, fluffy cotton candy clouds—one pink and blue, the other yellow and green—against the bright sky and a green tree. The final scene shows a woman wearing a beige hat and black top smiling broadly while holding the giant cotton candy in front of a colorful 'DECORA CREAMERY' sign.

The tempo is fast, approximately 130 BPM, with a driving electronic percussion section. The vocals are bright and energetic, with a high arousal level. There is no ambient noise or spoken dialogue from the video's creator. (2) As the video montages through the shopping mall scenes, the music continues without interruption. The bass line is prominent and rhythmic, providing a steady pulse that matches the fast visual cuts. The production is crisp and clean, typical of a professional studio recording, with high spectral brightness. (3) The musical structure remains consistent, utilizing synthesizers and electronic drum kits. There are no sound effects for the text overlays or scene transitions, allowing the music to remain the primary focus. The singer's voice remains energetic, contributing to a joyful and active atmosphere throughout the shopping sequence. The audio fidelity is high, with no technical artifacts or distortion. The track concludes with a natural rhythmic ending just as the video finishes, maintaining a high signal-to-noise ratio.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote a shopping experience at DiverCity Tokyo Plaza in Odaiba, Japan, specifically highlighting an exclusive 1,000 yen discount coupon for international tourists while showing the variety of stores and snacks available.
